definitions.explanation: The decade of age from 20 to 29 years old. Used to refer to a person's age range or a group of people in that age bracket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二十代|にじゅうだい}だ。
{二十代|にじゅうだい}のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I want to go abroad while I'm still in my twenties.

examples.japanese: {二十代|にじゅうだい}⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Fewer people have been getting married in their early twenties recently.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{二十|にじゅう}→二十：00975_nijuu⟧ (twenty) + ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (generation, age bracket). The ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ suffix is used with multiples of ten to indicate an age range.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二十代|にじゅうだい}⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧: early twenties (20-24)
- {二十代|にじゅうだい}⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧: late twenties (25-29)
- {二十代|にじゅうだい}⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧: mid-twenties
- {二十代|にじゅうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧/⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: men/women in their twenties

COMMON PATTERNS:
The same pattern applies to other decades: ⟦{三十代|さんじゅうだい}→三十代：16596_sanjuudai⟧ (thirties), ⟦{四十代|よんじゅうだい}→四十代：24046_yonjuudai⟧ (forties), ⟦{五十代|ごじゅうだい}→五十代：25926_gojuudai⟧ (fifties), etc. For teens, ⟦{十代|じゅうだい}→十代：16244_juudai⟧ covers ages 10-19.
